komentar:
Pertama2 kesannya wah enak ya kos disini rapi bersih, makin kesini makin ga banget. Sayang property bagus tp owner, management cove dan para penjaga malah kebalikannya. Thumbs down.

Cons:

Disini kos bareng temen sekamar berdua, bayar 500rb untuk tambahan org. Dari awal dikasih kunci cuma satu ga dikasih kunci extra, disuruh duplikat sendiri padahal posisi gw bayar untuk org kedua bukan numpang tinggal. Sebenernya mereka punya kunci lebih cuma ga mau kasih. Yg jaga rada moody dan jutek, kalau ada komplain apa2 disuruh langsung k Cove tp Cove nya jg ga bantu. Jawaban template itu2 doang.

Terjadi pd penanganangan masalah wifi. Wifi super lemot mati idup, tv d kamar jadi ga guna nonton buffering mulu. Penghuni minta owner turun tangan, tp bukannya benerin masalah wifi malah ngurusin masalah pemakaian kamar mandi luar (sharing) yg padahal selama ini aman2 ajj ga ada masalah ga ada complain. Issue nya karna rata2 yg kamar mandi sharing pd naroh peralatan mandi d dalam kamar mandi sharing, tp owner menilai itu ga rapi berantakan padahal gw sampai beli rak sendiri buat naroh perlengkapan mandi  biar rapi ga taroh sembarangan. Alhasil penjaga langsung angkut rak itu keluar dan taroh depan kamar mandi yg menurut gw justru jadi lebih ga rapi.

Pernah satu hari gw laundry sepatu d shoe care deket kost ini, udah kelar dan minta tolong petugasnya untuk drop d post jaga td siang. Malamnya gw pesen nasi kebuli 2 box, kasih intruksi driver untuk taroh d post jaga. Setengah jam kemudian gw turun mau ambil makanan sekalian sepatu, dan ternyata makanannya ga ada d post jaga ditanya k yg jaga katanya ga ada yg anter padahal d aplikasi grabfood driver udah fotoin dia naroh d meja post jaga. Trus gw liat penghuni lain ambil sepatu gw mikir itu sepatu dia, untung gw ada disana jg langsung gw bilang ajj itu sepatu gw dan memang sepatu gw. Gw jd curiga sebenernya makanan gw udah sampe tp diambil ama yg lain dan yg jaga jg ga meratiin bodoh amat. Pas ditanya mukanya jutek duluan.

Mereka jg kerjasama dgn satu usaha laundry, awal masuk gw pake jasa mereka tp pernah kehilangan 1 pcs underwear, 1 pair socks dan 1 pcs short jeans. Gw komplain tp ga ada ganti rugi yg setimpal, cuma digratisin laundry 1x dan itu ga sebanding dgn harga barang yg ilang.

Trus pernah ada kejadian pas mau mandi (note: gw pake kamar tipe kamar mandi luar biar lebih lega karna yg kamar mandi dalam sempit), trus ada poop dan pipis kucing d kamar mandi. Gw complain k yg jaga dan respondnya "namanya jg kucing liar kak kita jg ga liat dia naik". Gw langsung diem dan mikir sejak kapan kucing liar pipis dan poop d kamar mandi? Trus ada 15 menit baru dia datang buat bersihin, itupun setelah gw misuh2 nelpon roommate gw. It happens for a month karna ternyata ada satu penghuni d kamar sebelah yg ngasih makan kucing liar ini tp ga mau ngasuh penuh (gw tau karna pernah mergokin dia ngasih makan ini kucing). Lately kucing ini suka mantengin kalau lg makan d communal area lantai 2.

Another minus point, tanjakan parkiran motornya lumayan tinggi dan licin kalau ujan so better watch for your leg and ride, gw pernah kepleset sekali. Yg mengesalkan adalah kudu bayar 150rb lg untuk parkiran yg ga driver-friendly ini.

The worst of all, kalau pindah tp ga ngabarin mereka 1 bulan sebelumnya, deposit 1 juta hangus ga d balikin. Masuk kosan rugi keluar pun rugi.

Pro:

Fasilitas umum overall oke, mulai dr dapur, rooftop, communal area lantai 2, dan air isi ulang d tiap lantai. Sampah diambil tiap malam dan seluruh area disapu+pel tiap pagi. Kamar mandi luar yg sharing jg dibersihin tiap pagi.

Lokasinya strategis bgt memang, tengah2nya CP dan Ciputra, banyak makanan yg open 24 jam, alfamart cuma 200m (less than 5 menit jalan kaki). But again, banyak kosan jg sekitar sini.

Note:

Ini personal experience gw selama kost d Cove The Peak, experience penghuni lain mungkin berbeda. Tp saran gw buat yg mau kost disini better check lg review2 nya dan pikirin baik2 drpd menyesal.

komentar:
An nostalgic stay!
I used to live in the neighbourhood. As matter of fact the location is just behind my old hluse!
Yes the location might be a little bit hidden , since located in dead end road. But the good thing, it is still considerably nearby with the business centre ( sbcd) and good shopping malls ( ciputra world, plaza nusantara). But you might want to take motorcyle ride ( gojek, grab) since at least a kilometer to reach those location. The good side, it is located in residential area , so it is considerable quite.
The facilities are quite complete for 3 stars hotel. It has swimming pool! ( small one though), gym ( it has free weight, some treadmill, cross trainer, bench press station, even a pull up station), and laundry machines. It has also working space, and restaurant/ cafe.
For the room amenities is quite standard. I book studio room for 2 peoples. It has one big bed, a smart tv ( this is very good, since we can cast our phone to watch netflix , etc), individual air conditioner, mini fridge, tea maker ( it provides non calorie sweetener), and small kitchen set. The bathrooom provide separate shower room. Maybe the downside were there is no utensil for cooking ( pot, saucepan,etc), so i have no idea how to use cook without them. The amenities in the bathroom also very minimal ( only soap, shampoo, and dental kit). But again with 3 stars level it is quite good . Also need to mention a good addition that in the corridor outside the room, the provide free water dispenser. At least you can make your own cup noodle in the middle of night!
I purchase a separate breakfast for 86k rupiah. In my honest opinion, it is not the best meal that can be offered with such price, i am sorry to say. At that morning, they serve white rice ( not good quality of rice, since a little bit hard), soy sauced chicken ( this is the only protein and it is not my favourite thing), curly pasta thing, sauted vegetable ( corn with long beans), and tempe and bakwan fritters (which is cold and too crispy). They also served cereal station, white bread with packed jam selection and margarine, infused water, coffee and tea, and fruits ( papaya, watermelon and cantaloupe).
The hotel also have quite ample parking area.  The service also quick and no hassle. They are not requiring deposit.

The purpose of this stay was my participation as an official pacer at the Sanur Half Marathon. Because of this commitment, I needed to sleep early (around 19:00) and wake up at 01:00 in order to report for pacing duty at 03:00.

At approximately 19:30, the air conditioning in my room stopped working completely. I immediately contacted reception and was informed that there was a technical issue requiring a technician. I was told this could take 1–2 hours, with no certainty.

This timing was extremely problematic, as proper rest was essential for my race responsibilities. I was informed that no alternative room was available at that time. The only temporary solution offered was a fan, and I was told the AC would be fixed the following morning.

I clearly informed the reception that I would be away from 03:00 to approximately 08:00 and requested that the AC be repaired before my return, as I intended to rest again before checkout.

When I returned at 08:00, nothing had been fixed. At 09:30, technicians finally arrived, requiring me to leave the room during the repair process. As a result, I was unable to rest at all after completing my pacing duty.

An alternative room was offered only at 11:00 — approximately one hour before my scheduled checkout time. At that point, the offer was no longer a meaningful solution, as there was insufficient time to rest.

I requested compensation for the significant inconvenience and disruption, but the hotel refused, stating that I did not wait for the technician the night before. This reasoning is unreasonable, as I had clearly communicated my early wake-up time and race obligations. Furthermore, I was not allowed to speak with the manager, as I was informed they were off duty.

The hotel failed to:
•	Provide a functioning essential facility (air conditioning)
•	Offer a timely alternative room
•	Complete the repair within a reasonable timeframe
•	Take responsibility for the inconvenience caused

While the hotel is very new in a good location. Consider twice to book in case something goes wrong.

komentar:
Tucked away in Sanur, this place is such a hidden gem.

Rooms are spacious and thoughtfully designed. From the outside, you still get that strong Balinese character, while the interior feels modern, fresh, and well put together. Everything feels new and very well maintained. Amenities are complete, you get your own fridge, smart tv, a private terrace, and access to a shared kitchen with full kitchenware and free refill drinking water. It’s the kind of setup that makes staying in feel just as tempting as going out. I ended up cooking my own meals and spending most of my time here, happily switching between the room and the pool.

Speaking of the pool, that was what first caught my eye online, and I’m happy to say it looks even better in real life. Clean, inviting, and surrounded by trees, it stays pleasantly shaded during the day, making it perfect for long, lazy swims or simply lounging by the water.

The location hits a sweet spot. The beach is close, a minimarket sits just outside the alley within walking distance, yet the hotel itself is about 150 meters off the main road. That little distance makes all the difference, it’s calm, quiet, and never feels hectic.

At night, especially after rain, you can hear frogs and insects, which personally didn’t bother me at all, it actually added to the atmosphere. There are mosquitoes, but each room is already equipped with an electric mosquito repellent, so it’s well anticipated and handled.

All in all, this place delivers far more than expected for its price range. Comfortable, charming, and quietly special, I’ll definitely be coming back.

Been staying for a few days and will stay for about 1 month at least.

Rooms: The rooms are typically in good condition but it could have been cleaned better. There are still some dirts on the floor and stains on the wall. It is still liveable.

Service: Staff were really friendly and tries to help.

Deposit: Staff gave MIXED INFORMATION in regards to the deposit payment. One told me that if I use card payment, they can only refund if I have Indonesia Bank. So I had to go through the hassle and took out money from the ATM so that I can prepare the deposit during check in. Upon checking in, the staff (different staff) told me it’s best to pay by card and they will refund within 14 working days. The information given by staff is very confusing and I really don’t appreciate it.

Others: Property only provide kitchen appliances, plates, cups for daily rental, not monthly rental. Staff gave MIXED INFORMATION which I do not appreciate. One staff mention it’s possible for me to borrow some appliances, I just need to call the recept. Another staff mention they don’t provide because I booked under COVE and mine falls under rental.

I rented for one whole month and it does not make sense for me to buy all the appliances just for this month and ending up throwing everything during the check out. So I asked the staff and COVE as well if they could provide some leniency as I am staying for one month only. Unfortunately, they cannot help as it’s under management.COVE and property should at least ensure the information is consistent. The staff working at the property should at least ensure information is consistent as well. If I knew they don’t provide the appliances, I would not have booked this place for 1 month.
Staff at the properly should also at least provide some other options because I am paying quite an amount for me to stay here and they could at least provide me an alternative, even if it means paying extra. This is something I should not deal with as a short term traveller. Please do better on this.

The room was cramped, ink was all over the bedsheet, we did not know what it was. Even until 12 pm on June 15, we still did not have any response from the hotel.

Such a bad customer service. This is not the first action promised as they keep making the same mistake.This is also to inform that no further act will happen to anyone.

komentar:
Отличный, свежий отель в Южной Джакарте, рядом с огромным Lotte Mall и другими торговыми центрами.
Расположен в проулке, что делает его тихим.
Нет запаха сырости.

Очень порадовал тренажерный зал (чистый, новый, все необходимое есть), с видом на бассейн.

Очень классный, чистый , довольно длинный бассейн комфортной глубины для взрослого и ребенка 6 лет.

Уютный ресторан, достаточно вкусно и нормальный ценник, как и в городе.

Единственное, на завтраках ребенку нечего было есть особо . То есть завтрак не intercontinental , нет: хлопьев/йогуртов/ яичницы (но это не противоречит их информации, они об этом не заявляют нигде).

Также понравился услужливый персонал, у нас была необходимость периодически звонить по городу на локальный телефон , они предоставляли телефон.

Уборка ! Каждый день! Смена полотенец и смена белья - каждый день!
Доп полотенца у бассейна.

Бесплатные  стиральные и сушильные машины , что не может не радовать.

Хороший бесплатный интернет в номере и общих зонах , работать - комфортно.

Кому важно, чтобы отель был небольшим и уютным, то это здесь.
Мы в огромных отелях не любим жить.

Сейфа нет.

Есть небольшая кухня, но очень мало приборов для готовки . Выдали только кастрюлю (ни сковороды, ни лопаток, ни ножа - на кухне нет. Особо не рассчитывайте на нее).

Нормальных размеров холодильник, только гудит сильно ночью.

Большой телевизор с YouTube.
Сантехника также свежа. Кровать большая, спали втроем.

Мечетей в 4:30 утра практически не слышно, спать можно спокойно :).

Вобщем, для Джакарты, отличный вариант цена/качество.

The only service minded people here is the security guys - they are great though!
The rooms are barely cleaned. I stayed for 5 months (I know. I should have moved but I just coped) and the same dust stayed the whole duration of my stay on any surface that wasn't the floor. I also regularly got sheets and towels with stains or holes in them.
They don't know how to keep track of your deposit or payment - so remember to keep the receipt, they might ask for proof of payment way later, even though you payed in person at the reception desk (happend for me on monthly payment and deposits).
There is no equipment in the kitchen, not even one glass or knife - if you ask to borrow something, even just for eating one meal they will say "no, we can not lend you a fork". Okay fair enough, but for the price of the room I find it absurd. All in all not good value for money - at least not for long stays.
Oh also - electricity is not included, ok, but then they came up with the genius idea that an alarm will go of if you're running low on your top up (but not out of electricy yet) and this alarm will go off no matter the time of the day or NIGHT.
Only stayed there because it was close to my work. So location is nice close to Mega Kuningang, the building and facilities, such as gym and swimmingpool, are also great, the rooms would have been great if they were cleaned. All problems very fixable so I hope that the hotel might see to improve for future guests. Or lower the price to match the service.

For us, the location wasn't the best as the hotel is on the wrong side of the bypass and it was a mammoth task getting across the bypass in one piece.

No tourist info from the staff, not even able to give any info on the Ogoh Ogoh.

Je recommande vivement!

Pros:
- It has a gym and a pool, in house cafe on the first floor as well as a workspace.
- Located in Kuningan so it's quite centrally located.
- The staff members were very nice and helpful! I'd say they're the highlight of this hotel.
- Reception desk is available 24/7 and it was easy to receive deliveries as I could as the reception desk to receive them for me.
- Reasonably priced for what you get.

Cons:
- Internet was awful. The wifi connection isn't strong enough for a Zoom call. I was planning to work from my room but the wifi was terrible so I have to work from the workspace.
- There wasn't a "Do Not Disturb" sign for the door. As I didn't want the cleaners to clean my room on a daily basis, it would be useful to have them as I've been getting knock on my door every morning. I was informed by the reception that the cleaners will only clean if it's requested however that didn't seem to be the case.
- No safe in the room. I prefer keeping all of my important documents and valuables in a safe. However Cove The Day doesn't provide that in the room I stayed in.

Overall I'd say if you're looking for a place to stay in Jakarta that's centrally located and you'd be mostly spend your day outside of the hotel, this is a good choice. However, if you're like me, you're a remote worker who relies on stable and good internet connection to do your work and work from your hotel room, this place isn't for you.

Book elsewhere and avoid the disappointment and of course being scammed.

At only $50 per night, I got what I paid for. I stayed here for three nights for business.

The Room: The room is spacious and clean. There's a stove and a fridge which weren't of use to me. The bathroom again is surprisingly big with both rainshower and handheld combo available. Basic amenities are provided: shampoo, body soap, toothbrush, toothpaste, and bottled water.

The Service: Patchy. The check-in process was fuss free. But on my first night, I requested a hairdryer but was told all of their hairdryers were being used. They'd promised to deliver it to my room the next day. It didn't happen although I again asked for it. My room was cleaned after the first night, but it didn't happen after the second night; both times, I'd asked my room to be cleaned. I have no idea why.

The location: The landmark point is Tokopedia Tower or Ciputra World. You have to walk about 7 minutes along an alley to get to the hotel. All of the days, I walked back after 9 p.m., and the alley was decently litted, and I did not feel unsafe; no dodgy characters spotted at least. A taxi driver got lost trying to pick me up room the hotel once as the pick-up point wasn't the most obvious.

Kamarnya lumayan bagus saya dapat harga dibawah 200k. Kemarin dapat kamar di lantai 3 pas di depan tangga, ac nya tidak terlalu dingin padahal sudah di set 16°c, exhaustnya lumayan berisik jadi tidak saya nyalakan, lalu sprei dan sarung bantalnya banyak noda tapi point plusnya disini dapat dua guling.

Disediakan air minum, sikat gigi dan odol juga sabun mandi, ada water heaternya juga dan bekerja dengan baik. TV nya sudah smart tv jadi bisa nonton YouTube atau Netflix. Wifinya juga cukup kencang.

Parkirannya cukup luas bisa masuk motor dan satu mobil. Receptionist tidak selalu stand by di depan tapi ada ring bell jadi tinggal pencet dan staffnya nanti langsung keluar. Overall pilihan yang tepat bagi yang sekedar butuh tempat untuk tidur.

Fasilitas sangat lengkap dan pelayanan juga cukup helpful.

Kamar cukup luas dan bersih. Interiornya rapi dan gak sesak. Soal harga kalo saya compare sama yg sewa lepasan harganya terbilang cukup terjangkau sesuai pasaran. Bahkan dibanding sama fasilitasnya terbilang worth it.

Fasilitas dari apart:
- kolam renang (ada sejenis water gym gitu)
- ada taman dibawah dan di rooftop
- lapangan tennis
- lapangan basket
- gym
- function room, dll

Tambahan fasilitas COVE:
- lounge luas (meja bilyard dan tenis meja)
- dapur + pantry bersama (alat masak sangat lengkap)
- laundry room yg sudah ada dryer nya.
Semua fasilitas ini include harga sewa dan bisa dipakai gratis!

Lokasi cukup strategis (view bagus). Dekat akses tol. Kekurangannya cuma daerahnya macet.

So far semua staff juga ramah dan helpful, semoga akan tetap helpful selamanya.

Reviews are accurate.
Nice facilities but tricky to maintain quiet hours and the fridge does rotate frequently but it’s very limited (edit: 2 for 5 floors of residency)

For seniors, the stairs are rather tall. I don’t recommend them going up and down regularly to avoid possible knee injuries.

Edit: Additionally.

Road is regularly used by TJ angkot (like 4-5 passes by every 10 minutes) and the road is narrow, thus there is no place for a car to safely stop without impeding traffic.

I do not recommend parking or waiting to the left of the road (in front of the gates). A car fell into a rusted grate last time, closing the road for the entire day sometime in mid-May 2026.

The roads are closed at 9 PM but it’s a short walk from the barrier, so it’s not an issue.

Jujur kamar bagus banget! No debate.
But the BIG PROBLEM is, gue booking 3 malam di tempat ini dengan format "twin bed" karena memang sedang perjalanan dinas dengan tim. Sekali lagi "twin bed" gue pilih karena memang ada pilihannya app, setelah check in nyatanya tidak ada yg meyediakan twin bed. Its first mistake!
Dan gong nya adalah malam ini gue meeting dengan client balik larut malam (around 00.15AM), dan keanehan terjadi adalah seluruh akses masuk cove alexa "DITUTUP PORTAL", yes di tutup portal tanpa ada pemberitahuan, membuat gue muter² nyari akses masuk gang sampai 3x putaran dan hanya bisa masuk dari akses "pasar", ya pasar sayuran!
Second gong adalah ketika sampai di cove alexa, gue gabisa langsung parkir mobil karena parkir penuh dan tidak ada tempat untuk mobil gue, sehingga gue harus nunggu sampai satu jam, yap, sejam banget gue tunggu parkir mobil doang.
sampai jam 2 malam akhirnya gue ga tahan, gue minta refund.
Tolong perbaiki lagi kordinasi karyawan nya, sediakan lahan parkir yang memadahi, jangan buat tamu kecewa sampai merugikan cove alexa sendiri.

Saya book kos ini krn katanya free parkir mobil dan dapat TV di kamarnya, saya bayar booking fee sekitar 2 bulan sebelum saya menempati kos tsb. Tp ketika saya akan akan masuk ternyata ada biaya parkir yg harus dibayar dan TV pun juga tidak dipasang2 dan tidak ada kejelasan apapun soal itu. Akhirnya saya memutuskan untuk tdk jadi menempati kos tsb, booking fee pun hangus padahal jelas2 saya dibohongi dari awal. Pihak owner tidak mau mengembalikan booking fee sama sekali.

Review saya utk kost ini:
(+) bangunan baru.
(+) ada communal area.

(-) ketidakjelasan informasi antara pihak owner kost dan manajemen cove.
(-) kamar sempit, harus hidup minimalis dgn sedikit sekali barang apalagi lemari juga kecil sekali.
(-) minim storage.
(-) tidak ada parkir mobil. mobil bisa parkir di pinggir jalan di depan bangunan kost. Jalan tidak lebar dan relatif ramai krn dilalui angkutan umum.
(-) menurut saya harga kost cukup mahal padahal kamarnya sempit bgt.

Btw banyak kos sekitar situ yg lebih besar dan fasilitas lebih banyak dgn harga lebih murah kok.

To conclude, it was a really terrible experience at this hotel.

komentar: We booked this hotel very last minute late at night and arrived there the same hour we booked it because we couldn't get into our previous hotel at a different location. And we were able to check in really fast.  The receptionist at the time is really kind and helpful, he carried our luggage upstairs. He was also still there when we needed to check out really early in the morning. Honestly, this hotel is pretty okay for a last minute stay and only around $17. But, some negative sides are that the lobby does smell like cigarettes when you enter, there is only 1 outlet inside the whole room, and the bathroom was not very clean.

Saya menginap selama 2 hari 1 malam di tempat ini untuk menonton konser di area Sanur. Tempatnya cukup strategis dekat dengan supermarket dan gas station

Overall fasilitas kamar sangat bagus walaupun ada noda kecil di sprei tapi it doesn’t really bother me. Internetnya high speed dan water heaternya bekerja dengan baik. Saat checkin staff sikap membantu dan langsung menghubungi via WhatsApp untuk membagikan password wifi.

Satu concern saya ada di shared kitchen dimana cukup tidak terorganisir dengan baik. Saya tidak tahu mana gelas atau piring yang sudah di cuci karena peletakan yang berantakan. Jadi harus cuci lagi gelas/piring yang mau digunakan karena khawatir akan pakai bekas orang lain

I stayed here for a week. I love the ambience and the service. They offered daily cleaning room service and it was soooo thorough. The staff were friendly and kind, have a convo with few of them too about the area. I love that here is very quiet, perfect for me doing WFH job. If you'd wish to go to Southern area of Bali, it will be too far. But I planned my trip around Bangli and Gianyar, so staying here was definitely worth it. It's still close to Pantai Sanur too if you like surfing.

I love the room scent and the body wash scent also nice too, made me wonder where to buy that haha.

In summary,it exceeds my expectations.

P.S: WiFi speed is insanely fast.

The serviced apartment is well-located near office buildings and shopping malls, but walking around can be quite challenging. The pedestrian access is limited, with narrow alleys and areas that feel unsafe for walking, so using ride-hailing services like Gojek is generally the more convenient option.

On the positive side, the service is good and the staff are attentive. The security team is especially friendly and helpful, and they kept my online food deliveries and items safe and well-managed. The unit itself is well-equipped with useful amenities such as a washing machine, a decent kitchen, a smart TV, and a comfortable bed. The space is also large and generally well maintained and cleaned.

Overall, it is a good option for a long stay, especially for those looking to stay in central Jakarta and rely mainly on ride-hailing for transportation.

場所は、ビーチや観光地からはかなり離れているので、バイクなどが必要でしょう。レストランなどは周りにたくさんあります。
部屋は悪くはないですが、TVにほこりなどが溜まっていて、清掃はいまいちかと感じました。
部屋に冷蔵庫、ケトル、ドライヤーなどはありませんが、スマートTVがあってNetflixなどが見られます。
共有ルームが１階にあり、ディスペンサー、冷蔵庫、簡易キッチンなどもそこにあります。
ベッドの脇に小さいライトがあったり、ハンガーもたくさんあったりするのは、よかったです。

スタッフはそこらへんにいる普通の若者で、英語は通じません。ジャカルタにある同じ系列のホテルにも泊まりましたが、同じような感じでした。

komentar:
Saya punya pengalaman yang luar biasa dengan flatnya, indah dengan kolam renang yang besar, dan pengurus rumah tangganya sangat baik. Namun, saya punya pengalaman yang sangat buruk dengan Cove Management, terutama staf keuangan dan penjualan mereka yang berantakan. Saya menginap di sana dari Februari. Cove memiliki kebijakan penjualan dan pemasaran yang buruk, dan tim keuangan mereka lebih buruk lagi. Tidak ada transparansi pada tagihan listrik, mereka menagih saya 700 ribu untuk listrik dan 300 ribu lagi dalam satu bulan! Harga kamar akan naik hampir 40-50% setelah bulan pertama, hanya murah di awal dengan alasan 'promo'. Selalu mengirimi saya faktur deposit, mengirim spam setiap hari di WhatsApp, meskipun semuanya sudah dibayar!! Sangat berantakan!

Mereka terus-menerus memberikan diskon untuk penyewa baru, tetapi mereka sangat ragu untuk memberikan diskon untuk penyewa setia. Tingkat hunian kost bahkan tidak mencapai 50%, sebagian besar penyewa pergi dalam satu bulan. Semua kamar di lantai 3 kosong. Saya mencoba memesan untuk teman saya, tetapi mereka bilang semua kamar sudah penuh karena mereka pikir saya memesan kamar dengan KTP lain, padahal kamarnya kosong! Bagi penyewa baru yang ingin menginap jangka panjang, tempat ini bukan pilihan yang tepat!

Tanpa harga diskon, lebih baik menginap di akomodasi lain di dekatnya. Dengan harga yang sama, Anda bisa mendapatkan apartemen studio di dekatnya, dengan fasilitas yang secara keseluruhan lebih baik, karena mereka menyediakan kolam renang, pusat kebugaran, minimarket, pusat jajanan, dan ruang bersama. Kamarnya juga lebih luas!

Saya pikir pemilik properti lebih baik tanpa Cove, karena Cove hanya menaikkan harga dan menciptakan harga yang tidak adil. Mereka bahkan tidak membantu Anda mendapatkan hunian meskipun sudah banyak iklan dan pemasaran. Tenaga penjualan mereka juga tidak dapat mempertahankan penyewa karena kemampuan komunikasi mereka sangat buruk! Sama halnya dengan akomodasi yang begitu indah!

Oke untuk anggaran terbatas & transit saja. Jangan berharap terlalu tinggi untuk tempat ini.

- Kamar: Rasio antara kamar tidur dan kamar mandi agak tidak seimbang...
- Kebersihan/Fasilitas: Anda dapat dengan cepat melihat bahwa ini dulunya properti yang bagus tetapi tidak ditangani/dipelihara dengan baik. Banyak sekali noda di seprai, dinding, bahkan meja?? Tidak ada pengecatan ulang yang terlihat. Saya rasa mereka bahkan tidak membersihkan debu/mengepel lantai sama sekali. Sangat aneh dan absurd bagaimana tempat ini menjadi buruk. Ini bahkan bukan pekerjaan pembersihan yang sulit karena saya bisa menggosok noda di meja...
- Suasana: Saya tidak tahu bagaimana menilai ini
- Fasilitas: Saya juga tidak tahu bagaimana menilai ini. Jangan berharap banyak. Ada Kopi Kenangan untuk minum kopi cepat
- Lokasi: Terlihat dari papan nama Kopi Kenangan. Dan saya rasa tempat parkirnya tidak terlalu besar
- Pelayanan: Tidak ada masalah dengan staf.

komentar:
Ulasan-ulasan tersebut akurat.
Fasilitasnya bagus tetapi sulit untuk menjaga ketenangan dan kulkas memang sering diganti tetapi jumlahnya sangat terbatas (edit: 2 untuk 5 lantai tempat tinggal).

Untuk lansia, tangga agak tinggi. Saya tidak menyarankan mereka naik turun tangga secara teratur untuk menghindari kemungkinan cedera lutut.

Edit: Tambahan.

Jalan tersebut sering digunakan oleh angkot TJ (sekitar 4-5 kali lewat setiap 10 menit) dan jalannya sempit, sehingga tidak ada tempat bagi mobil untuk berhenti dengan aman tanpa menghambat lalu lintas.

Saya tidak menyarankan parkir atau menunggu di sebelah kiri jalan (di depan gerbang). Sebuah mobil jatuh ke dalam jeruji besi berkarat terakhir kali, menutup jalan sepanjang hari sekitar pertengahan Mei 2026.

Jalan ditutup pukul 9 malam tetapi jaraknya dekat dari pembatas, jadi tidak masalah.
